messages:
CI Bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Deploy pipeline failed for release/2026-03-15 (canary) - 5/5 canaries unhealthy, returning 502s. Auto-rollout paused. Logs attached.
Jordan S: seeing this in prod-canary, 502s on inference endpoints. Not all pods, looks like a subset with new image tag.
Mei Li: looks like image tag used is `registry.redwood/inference:2026-03-15-retagged` which is wrong — CI should have pushed `:2026-03-15`. Could be a mutable tag was retagged after build.
Sanjay Patel: ack. Paging oncall. @Alex (oncall) can you take?
Alex (oncall): on it. joining huddle. First pass: we need to prevent further rollout to remaining clusters and assess customer impact.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by deploy-bot at step=canary-verify. Pipeline id=ci-7890.
Jordan S: rolling a kill-switch on the feature flag now — toggling `feature.new-render` -> off in LaunchDarkly. Command: `ldctl set feature.new-render false --env=prod`
Mei Li: good call. Also we should immediately pin traffic away from canary nodes with the bad image. Suggest swapping service selector to exclude nodes with `pod-template-hash=bad`.
Sanjay Patel: I can do a quick scaledown of the problematic ReplicaSet: `kubectl scale rs rs-inference-abc123 --replicas=0 -n prod`. Will that interrupt other replicas? only affects that RS.
Alex (oncall): go ahead but be careful — we need to avoid flapping the LB. Coordinate with me before drain.
Jordan S: adding rollback plan: either undo to previous replicaset or force-deploy correct image tag. Which is faster?
Mei Li: undo is safer: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=56 -n prod`. That will restore the stable image and pick up healthy pods.
Sanjay Patel: undo started. Logs:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference --to-revision=56 -n prod
deployment.apps/inference rolled back
waiting for replicas to become ready...
```
Jordan S: monitoring metrics. 502s dropping on canaries, p50 latency normalizing.
CI Bot: Pipeline ci-7890 marked failed; artifact `registry.redwood/inference:2026-03-15-retagged` flagged as mutable-tag-alert.
Alex (oncall): Good. Now incident classification: impact: degraded inference responses for ~8% of requests for ~14 minutes. Customers with heavy streaming usage may have seen timeouts. Any known customer pings?
Jordan S: Support reports one customer complained about increased latencies (case #4521). Not widespread, we didn't hit SLA thresholds but noticeable.
Mei Li: Root cause hypothesis: mutable tag `:2026-03-15` was reassigned by a downstream release script that re-used the tag for a hotfix image, causing canary machines to pull unintended layers (cache poisoning). The CI pipeline allowed mutable tags for the canary promotion step.
Sanjay Patel: Evidence: registries show digest mismatch between expected sha256:aaa... vs pulled sha256:bbb... for that tag. `skopeo inspect docker://registry.redwood/inference:2026-03-15` output included digest bbb...
Alex (oncall): Action items (live):
- [ ] Confirm rollback fully healthy (Jordan)
- [ ] Temporarily ban mutable tags in canary promotion step (Mei)
- [ ] Add registry webhook to alert on tag->digest changes after initial push (Sanjay)
- [ ] Notify support and create postmortem ticket (Alex)
Jordan S: rollback confirmed healthy. All canaries now returning 200. Latency back to baseline.
Mei Li: I'm patching the pipeline: change promotion step to require digest pinned tag OR use unique immutable tags (sha suffix). Pushing hotfix now to CI branch.
Sanjay Patel: setting up registry watcher rule to detect retag events and alert `#eng-infra` and `#security`. Prototype script:
```
# pseudocode
watch_tags() {
  for tag in recent_tags; do
    current_digest=$(registry.inspect $tag)
    if last_seen_digest[tag] != current_digest; then
      alert("mutable-tag-change", tag)
    fi
  done
}
```
deploy-bot: blocked further promotions of `{tag: 2026-03-15}` until CI config updated.
Alex (oncall): Notifying support: please send templated note about partial impact and resolution. Jordan please paste mitigation timeline.
Jordan S: timeline: 21:35 UTC alert from CI Bot; 21:36 oncall paged; 21:38 feature flag off; 21:40 undone deployment initiated; 21:44 rollback healthy; 21:52 deploy-bot blocked tag promotions and pipeline patched.
ops-pager: Page summary sent to paging list.
Mei Li: postmortem owner volunteer: Mei Li with Sanjay + Jordan as co-authors. Will include remediation (immutable tags, registry webhook, stricter CI checks).
Sanjay Patel: follow-up: schedule a canary run with pinned images to verify pipeline guard rails, I can run it in staging.
Alex (oncall): closing live incident in channel. If anything else surfaces re-open the thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Jordan S: thanks team. I'll update the support case and link the postmortem when ready.
CI Bot: Incident closed (auto) - duration 17 minutes, action-required: pipeline changes.
